run_in2bin_convert: run in2bin.py on a text data file to convert it to binary format using struct.pack
run_in2bin_cli: run the in2bin.py script with a file path argument to produce a binary output file
test_in2bin_conversion: test in2bin.py by providing a file that defines type and input variables for binary packing
review_in2bin_exec: review in2bin.py which uses exec to read type and input variables from an input file
summarize_in2bin_struct: summarize in2bin.py which packs data using struct.pack with a format string and value list
